Delhi Metro Stations Closed Ahead of CEC Protest

Ahead of a planned protest at Jantar Mantar, 11 Delhi Metro stations were shut down and security was heightened. Section 163 was also imposed in connection with the proposed demonstration against the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC).
